policies.name: contribution_grants_insert_own
policies.check:
((contributor_id = public.current_contributor_id()) AND (accepted_at <= now()) AND (accepted_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)) AND public.capture_is_open() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.terms_versions t
  WHERE ((t.version = contribution_grants.terms_version) AND (t.published_at <= contribution_grants.accepted_at) AND ((t.retired_at IS NULL) OR (t.retired_at > contribution_grants.accepted_at))))))

policies.name: contributors_insert_self

constraints.name: actors_human_is_a_contributor
constraints.definition: CHECK (((kind = 'human'::text) = ((contributor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (operator_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: contribution_grants_attribution_safe
constraints.definition: CHECK (((attribution_name = btrim(attribution_name)) AND (attribution_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (attribution_name !~ '[\u00ad\u061c\u180e\u200b-\u200f\u202a-\u202e\u2060-\u2069\ufeff]'::text) AND (attribution_name !~ '[<>{}\[\]\\`|^~$*=#@]'::text) AND (attribution_name !~* '([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://|www\.)'::text))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: gold_labels_canonical_unit
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((property = ANY (ARRAY['soc'::text, 'clay'::text, 'sand'::text, 'silt'::text, 'n'::text])) AND (unit = 'g/kg'::text)) OR ((property = 'ph'::text) AND (unit = 'pH'::text)) OR ((property = 'bd'::text) AND (unit = 'kg/dm3'::text)) OR ((property = 'cec'::text) AND (unit = 'cmol(+)/kg'::text))))

constraints.name: gold_labels_submission_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id) REFERENCES public.submissions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: photos_camera_metadata_allowlist
constraints.definition: CHECK (((camera_metadata_private IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(camera_metadata_private) = 'object'::text) AND ((camera_metadata_private - ARRAY['make'::text, 'model'::text, 'focal_length_mm'::text, 'exposure_time_s'::text, 'f_number'::text, 'iso'::text, 'color_space'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (((camera_metadata_private ->> 'color_space'::text) IS NULL) OR ((camera_metadata_private ->> 'color_space'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['srgb'::text, 'display_p3'::text, 'other'::text, 'none'::text]))))))

constraints.name: photos_capture_evidence_allowlist
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((capture_evidence_private IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(capture_evidence_private) = 'object'::text) AND ((capture_evidence_private - ARRAY['evidence_version'::text, 'exif_time_present'::text, 'exif_time_absolute'::text, 'exif_time_delta_s'::text, 'exif_age_at_acceptance_s'::text, 'exif_gps_present'::text, 'exif_gps_distance_m'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (capture_evidence_private ?& ARRAY['evidence_version'::text, 'exif_time_present'::text, 'exif_time_absolute'::text, 'exif_time_delta_s'::text, 'exif_age_at_acceptance_s'::text, 'exif_gps_present'::text, 'exif_gps_distance_m'::text]) AND (jsonb_typeof((capture_evidence_private -> 'evidence_version'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((capture_evidence_private -> 'exif_time_present'::text)) = 'boolean'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((capture_evidence_private -> 'exif_time_absolute'::text)) = 'boolean'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((capture_evidence_private -> 'exif_gps_present'::text)) = 'boolean'::text) AND
CASE jsonb_typeof((capture_evidence_private -> 'exif_time_delta_s'::text))
    WHEN 'null'::text THEN true
    WHEN 'number'::text THEN ((((capture_evidence_private ->> 'exif_time_delta_s'::text))::numeric % (1)::numeric) = (0)::numeric)
    ELSE false
END AND
CASE jsonb_typeof((capture_evidence_private -> 'exif_age_at_acceptance_s'::text))
    WHEN 'null'::text THEN true
    WHEN 'number'::text THEN ((((capture_evidence_private ->> 'exif_age_at_acceptance_s'::text))::numeric % (1)::numeric) = (0)::numeric)
    ELSE false
END AND
CASE jsonb_typeof((capture_evidence_private -> 'exif_gps_distance_m'::text))
    WHEN 'null'::text THEN true
    WHEN 'number'::text THEN ((((capture_evidence_private ->> 'exif_gps_distance_m'::text))::numeric % (1)::numeric) = (0)::numeric)
    ELSE false
END)))
